Subject: Internal: Draft responses for Acme implementation questionnaire — review required

Team —

I'm working on the Acme RFP workbook and have drafted the implementation and migration responses. I attached the spreadsheet and a short runbook draft. Please review the sections called out below and reply with redlines by EOD Tue Mar 3 so we can send to the customer next day.

Quick summary of our proposed plan (for inclusion in the workbook):

- Phase 0 — Discovery & Prep (2 weeks)
  - Kickoff, network/identity intake, compliance checklist, security scoping
  - Deliverable: mutual action plan, network diagram, and access list

- Phase 1 — Private Deployment & Integration (3 weeks)
  - Provision private control plane (customer VPC), configure KMS integration (bring-your-own-key optional), deploy dedicated GPU pool templates
  - Integrations: API gateway routing, SSO (SAML/OIDC), SIEM log forwarding (syslog/HTTPS)
  - Customer tasks: approve network CIDRs, whitelist service endpoints, provide sample data for validation

- Phase 2 — Data Migration & Performance Tuning (2-4 weeks)
  - Bulk ingest (parallelized S3 -> Redwood), KV cache warmup, quantization profiles applied for cost/latency targets
  - Smoke tests: end-to-end inference on representative prompts, perf/latency baselining
  - Customer tasks: provide data export access and sample queries, approve performance SLA targets

- Phase 3 — Canary Rollout (2 weeks)
  - Canary pattern: 1% traffic -> 10% -> 25% -> 100% (each stage min 48 hours monitoring window)
  - Monitoring metrics and gates: response latency p95 <= target, error rate <= 0.5%, quality regression using eval prompt set <= 2% degradation
  - Automatic rollback triggers: sustained latency threshold breach, error spike, or quality regression beyond gate for 2 consecutive sampling windows
  - Deliverable: Canary Runbook, automated playbooks (runbook attached)

- Phase 4 — Cutover & Hypercare (1 week)
  - Final cutover during low-traffic window, support handover, 2-week hypercare window with daily status calls

Total elapsed time (typical): 8-12 weeks depending on customer network and data migration constraints.

Open technical questions we should confirm in the workbook:
- Do they require air-gapped deployment? If yes, lead time increases significantly and we'll need an on-prem engagement.
- Do they want persistent vector store migration handled by Redwood or a lift-and-shift approach by Acme?

Attachments: Acme_RFP_Implementation_Responses.xlsx (draft), Canary_Runbook_v1.pdf, Migration_Timeline_Gantt.png

Please add technical notes inline in the sheet (tab: "EngineeringNotes") and flag anything that will materially alter the timeline.

Thanks — M

Tom —

Attached is our completed Implementation & Migration Plan workbook and a separate Canary Runbook PDF outlining rollout stages, monitoring gates, and automated rollback triggers. Highlights below for your scoring sheet:

- Proposed schedule: 8-12 weeks typical (detailed Gantt attached). We show a 9-week path for the mid-sized profile you described assuming standard VPC peering and bulk S3 ingest.
- Integration steps: Private control plane deployment, SSO/SAML setup, KMS key exchange, SIEM/webhook config. Each integration task lists estimated Acme owner and effort hours in the workbook.
- Canary plan: 1% -> 10% -> 25% -> 100% with 48-hour minimum observation windows; gates include p95 latency, 0.5% error ceiling, and automated quality checks against your eval prompts.
- Data migration: We recommend bulk parallel ingest into a staging cluster, validation, then switch to live indexing during canary ramp. We provide rollback procedures to revert to prior index snapshot and route traffic back to the existing endpoint.
- Cutover & hypercare: 1-week scheduled cutover + 2 weeks of daily monitoring and on-call coverage.

Dependencies and items we ask Acme to complete pre-Phase 1 (summarized in workbook):
- Network approvals (VPC peering or private endpoints)
- Service account & S3 read access for bulk transfer
- KMS key rotation policy confirmation if BYOK is selected

Files attached: Acme_RFP_Implementation_Responses.xlsx (final), Canary_Runbook_v1.pdf, Migration_Timeline_Gantt.png
